data.title: World powers gather in Pacific to chart climate battle
data.description: WELLINGTON - World powers are flying delegates to the Pacific to haggle over the fight against global warming, and to see the plight of island nations surrounded by a rising ocean.

data.title: Taiwan receives its first US-made F-16V fighter jets
data.description: TAITUNG (TAIWAN) - Taiwan received on Friday its first F-16V fighter jets made by the United States, as the island democracy upgrades its military capabilities to deter a potential Chinese attack.

data.title: Lula, Bolsonaro trade scandal fire in final scramble for votes
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his election rival Flavio Bolsonaro are leaving no controversy unturned in their last-ditch efforts to discredit each other and win over voters ahead of Sunday's nail-biter election.

data.title: Return of swarming moth spectacle has Australia in a flutter
data.description: SYDNEY - Moth swarms so thick they can blot out the stars are fluttering across Australia, heralding a migratory spectacle unseen since the creature's brush with extinction nearly 10 years ago.

data.title: Nepal's grim DNA puzzle to identify flood dead
data.description: NUWAKOT (NEPAL) - Clutching a photograph of his missing son, Rajesh Ram is pinning his hopes on deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) testing -- like thousands of others desperately seeking relatives swept away by Nepal's catastrophic Himalayan floods.

data.title: Arab Israeli candidate drops out of election race
data.description: JERUSALEM — Arab Israeli politician Sami Abu Shehadeh withdrew his candidacy on Thursday from October's parliamentary election after Israel's Supreme Court indicated a majority of its judges supported barring him from the race.

data.title: Viral anti-vax posts weaponise Philippine inoculation fears
data.description: MANILA - When Jenette Torres Odena's three-year-old son fell ill days after receiving a jab as part of a Philippine vaccination drive, his photograph quickly spread on Facebook alongside claims the inoculation had killed him.

data.title: Israel courts Europe's far right, finding friends but also unease
data.description: JERUSALEM - Facing growing isolation over the war in Gaza, Israel is increasingly allying itself with Europe's far right, despite some parties' legacies of antisemitism.

data.title: Saudi coalition accuses Houthis of drone attack on Medina
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis struck an electricity distribution station in the holy city of Medina in Saudi Arabia, the Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday, sparking strong condemnation from the Muslim world.

data.title: US says 'in Europe's best interest' to cooperate on fuel supply
data.description: MILWAUKEE - The United States told Europe on Thursday to cooperate with Washington's efforts to lower diesel prices, while a top EU official said a US export ban of the fuel would be "unexpected."

data.title: A saintly spat and debate snub: Brazil enters final polls stretch
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazil's electoral court has ordered the takedown of "untrue" social media posts about the country's patron saint, the latest row at the end of a deeply divisive election campaign that will see President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva snub the main debate on Thursday.

data.title: Trump vows to hit Iran 'very hard' if linked to flydubai attack
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump said Thursday that Tehran was likely involved in an attack by a pilot on a flydubai flight to Israel and that Iran would be "hit very hard" if it was.

data.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea break diplomatic ties over conflict
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Ethiopia and Eritrea broke diplomatic ties on Thursday, accusing each other of stoking internal conflicts as fighting continued in northern Ethiopia.

data.title: Libya's pay strike rallies teachers across divided nation
data.description: TRIPOLI - In Libya, a teachers' strike over pay has shut schools and delayed the start of the school year, rallying educators across the oil-rich but politically divided country.

data.title: How airlines try to make sure pilots are safe to fly
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - The apparent attack by the co-pilot on a flight to Israel, in which he stabbed his captain and tried to crash the plane, is a reminder that the cockpit is an extremely sensitive place in terms of aviation safety.

data.title: Family of woman killed by US immigration agent sues Trump administration
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The family of Renee Good, an unarmed US citizen shot dead by an immigration agent during a sweeping federal crackdown, sued President Donald Trump's administration on Thursday, alleging wrongful death and civil rights violations.

data.title: Bolivia's attorney general arrested for alleged money laundering and drug trafficking
data.description: LA PAZ - US-sanctioned Bolivian Attorney General Roger Mariaca has been arrested on suspicion of money laundering and drug trafficking, with police finding bundles of cash smuggled out of his house, the government said Thursday.

data.title: Malawi ex-army chief arrested following allegations over Sudan arms
data.description: LILONGWE - Malawi's anti-corruption agency said it arrested the previous army chief on Thursday on allegations including dealing in property linked to "terrorism".

data.title: Finland investigates suspected break-ins at MPs homes
data.description: HELSINKI - Finnish authorities said Thursday they were investigating a slew of suspected break-ins at the homes of members of parliament, which the prime minister said could "very likely" be linked to a foreign power.

data.title: London's Bayeux Tapestry show to offer audio tour for blind people
data.description: LONDON - The British Museum will provide an audio-described tour of the Bayeux Tapestry after a visually impaired man objected to a lack of provision for the blind and partially-sighted.

data.title: Two Russian drones hit major bridge in Kyiv
data.description: KYIV — Russian drones on Thursday hit a major bridge in Kyiv for the first time since the start of the conflict with Ukraine, as Moscow stepped up its strikes on key infrastructure ahead of winter.

data.title: Israelis swell with pride over foiled plane disaster
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israelis swelled with pride Thursday after passengers wrested control of a plane to prevent near-certain death, days before the anniversary of the October 7 attack, their country's worst-ever security failure.

data.title: Bosnian Serb 'Iron Lady' war crimes convict Plavsic dies aged 96
data.description: SARAJEVO - Former Bosnian Serb president and war crimes convict Biljana Plavsic, known as the 'Iron Lady', died in the Serbian capital on Thursday, aged 96, local media reported.

data.title: UAE probes possible ‘terror’ incident on flight to Israel
data.description: DUBAI - The United Arab Emirates says it is investigating a possible “terrorist” link to an apparent attack by a pilot on board a flight to Israel that was diverted to Saudi Arabia, after passengers intervened to prevent the plane from crashing.

data.title: Afghanistan says deadly Pakistani strikes hit Helmand
data.description: KABUL — The Pakistani military launched rare deadly strikes on Afghanistan's Helmand province on Thursday, the Taliban government and residents told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: Kremlin critic, chess legend Kasparov says US intelligence warned life 'in danger'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Kremlin critic and chess legend Garry Kasparov said Thursday that US and Lithuanian security services had told him and his ally that their lives were in danger and urged them to take security precautions.

data.title: Indian pilot hailed as ‘hero’ after cockpit struggle
data.description: MUMBAI — Indian pilot Smit Machchhar was hailed as a "hero" on Thursday after fighting to retain control of a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight when his co-pilot attacked him, leaving him wounded but helping avert disaster.

data.title: Plastic treaty talks chair sees deal possible in March
data.description: Countries negotiating a world-first treaty to limit plastic pollution are less divided than before and a deal could be agreed in March, the diplomat chairing the talks told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) on Thursday.

data.title: US woman survives lethal-drug execution attempt
data.description: Christa Pike, convicted of murdering a schoolmate three decades ago, survived an attempt to execute her by means of lethal injection late on Wednesday, foiling the first attempt to put a woman to death in Tennessee for two centuries.

data.title: Man City scandal could taint Premier League brand
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - The Premier League has won a lengthy legal battle with Manchester City over financial impropriety, but the consequences could leave lasting damage for a league that has long since become the envy of world football.

data.title: Japan tightens permanent residency rules for foreigners
data.description: TOKYO - Japan has toughened requirements for foreigners wanting to obtain permanent residency, as part of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s push to tighten immigration controls.

data.title: Dozens wounded as French school protests escalate
data.description: PARIS - French security forces on Wednesday detained over 600 people while dozens of police and gendarmes were wounded as protests that have seen blockades of high schools and violent clashes escalated, the interior minister said.

data.title: EU seeking better ways to manage deportations
data.description: BRUSSELS - The European Union will discuss further ways to boost migrant deportations on Thursday, as a group of nations forges ahead with divisive plans to send failed asylum-seekers to return centres outside the bloc.

data.title: Hundreds held, dozens wounded as French school protests escalate
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French security forces on Wednesday detained over 600 people while dozens of police and gendarmes were wounded as protests that have seen blockades of high schools and violent clashes escalated, the interior minister said.

data.title: 'Catastrophic': Swiss glaciers lose fifth of mass in five years
data.description: LES DIABLERETS (SWITZERLAND) - Switzerland's glaciers, which are disproportionately impacted by climate change, have lost nearly 20 percent of their mass in five years, experts said Thursday, with 2026 registering the second-biggest melt on record.

data.title: US government's new AI chatbot pulls back from debunking Trump
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump unveiled what he called a "damn good" AI chatbot, but it quickly drew attention for contradicting some of his contentious political claims.
